games.duckhunt.rules: {olive}One prisoner is the duck: fast, floaty and flying (hold jump). Everyone else no-scopes it out of the sky. The hunter who drops the duck wins; the duck wins by surviving.
games.duckhunt.countdown: {olive}The duck takes off in {green}{0}{olive} seconds. Hunters, get your guns ready - only the duck can be hurt.
games.duckhunt.you_are_duck: You are the duck! Hold jump to fly.
games.duckhunt.released: {olive}The duck {0}{olive} is flying! Shoot it down - it wins after {green}{1}{olive} seconds.
